title: Ability
subtitle: 能力，究竟是怎樣的「能力」？
description: 能力，究竟是怎樣的「能力」？

words.meaning: 能力；承受／處理能力；容量
words.note: 表示某人或某系統能夠承擔、處理、理解或完成多少。
words.example: She has the capacity to manage several complex projects at the same time.
words.exampleZh: 她有能力同時管理多個複雜項目。

exercises.original: She has the ability to manage several demanding projects at the same time.
exercises.upgrade: She has the capacity to manage several demanding projects at the same time.

options.explanation: 強調可承擔和處理多少工作。

exercises.original: Young children have a limited ability to concentrate for long periods.
exercises.upgrade: Young children have a limited capacity to concentrate for long periods.

options.explanation: 表示可維持注意力的能力範圍。

words.note: 表示某人、組織或系統具有完成某類任務的能力或功能。
words.example: The new software has the capability to process large amounts of data quickly.
words.exampleZh: 這套新軟件具備快速處理大量數據的能力。

exercises.original: The new system has the ability to detect unusual activity automatically.
exercises.upgrade: The new system has the capability to detect unusual activity automatically.

options.explanation: 適合描述系統或技術功能。

exercises.original: The organization needs to improve its ability to respond to emergencies.
exercises.upgrade: The organization needs to improve its capability to respond to emergencies.

options.explanation: 組織層面的實際應對能力。

words.note: 表示一個人天生或很早就顯示出的學習某類技能的傾向或潛力。
words.example: She showed a natural aptitude for languages at an early age.
words.exampleZh: 她很小就展現出語言方面的天分。

exercises.original: He showed a natural ability for mathematics from a very young age.
exercises.upgrade: He showed a natural aptitude for mathematics from a very young age.

options.explanation: natural 和年幼時就顯現，直接指向天資。

exercises.original: The test measures each applicant's ability to learn mechanical tasks quickly.
exercises.upgrade: The test measures each applicant's aptitude for learning mechanical tasks quickly.

options.explanation: 測量學習某類工作的潛質。

words.note: 表示透過學習和練習形成的具體做事能力。
words.example: Clear writing is an important skill in many professions.
words.exampleZh: 清晰寫作是很多職業都很重要的一項技能。

exercises.original: Negotiating effectively is an important ability for managers.
exercises.upgrade: Negotiating effectively is an important skill for managers.

options.explanation: 談判是可學習和練習的具體能力。

exercises.original: Years of practice improved her ability to control the instrument precisely.
exercises.upgrade: Years of practice improved her skill at controlling the instrument precisely.

options.explanation: years of practice 指後天習得技巧。

words.note: 表示一個人具備完成工作所需的足夠知識、技能和判斷力。
words.example: The assessment is designed to test professional competence.
words.exampleZh: 這項評核是用來測試專業勝任能力的。

exercises.original: The assessment tests whether candidates have the ability to perform the job safely.
exercises.upgrade: The assessment tests whether candidates have the competence to perform the job safely.

options.explanation: 重點是是否達到安全勝任工作的要求。

exercises.original: The regulator questioned the contractor's professional ability after repeated safety failures.
exercises.upgrade: The regulator questioned the contractor's professional competence after repeated safety failures.

options.explanation: professional competence 表示是否稱職。

words.note: 表示在某項技能上的熟練水平，常可被測量或分級。
words.example: Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in written English.
words.exampleZh: 申請人必須證明具備熟練的英語寫作能力。

exercises.original: Applicants must show a high level of ability in written English.
exercises.upgrade: Applicants must show a high level of proficiency in written English.

options.explanation: 常用於語言技能的熟練程度。

exercises.original: The course helps users develop greater ability in spreadsheet software.
exercises.upgrade: The course helps users develop greater proficiency in spreadsheet software.

words.note: 表示一個人對某類活動具有較突出的自然能力。
words.example: He has a remarkable talent for explaining difficult ideas simply.
words.exampleZh: 他很有把複雜概念解釋得簡單易懂的才能。

exercises.original: She has a remarkable natural ability for composing music.
exercises.upgrade: She has a remarkable natural talent for composing music.

options.explanation: natural 和藝術創作很適合 talent。

exercises.original: His ability to make complex ideas easy to understand is unusual.
exercises.upgrade: His talent for making complex ideas easy to understand is unusual.

words.note: 較正式，表示人的某種心智、感官或認知能力。
words.example: Stress can affect the faculty of clear judgment.
words.exampleZh: 壓力可能影響清晰判斷的能力。

exercises.original: Age can affect a person's ability to remember names quickly.
exercises.upgrade: Age can affect a person's faculty for remembering names quickly.

options.explanation: 正式表示心智或認知能力。

exercises.original: Sleep deprivation can reduce the ability to make sound judgments.
exercises.upgrade: Sleep deprivation can reduce the faculty of sound judgment.

options.explanation: 正式表示判斷這類心智能力。

words.note: 表示尚未完全實現、但未來可能發展出的能力。
words.example: The coach believes the young player has enormous potential.
words.exampleZh: 教練相信這名年輕球員有很大的發展潛力。

exercises.original: The young designer has the ability to become one of the best in the industry.
exercises.upgrade: The young designer has the potential to become one of the best in the industry.

options.explanation: 指未來可發展出的能力。

exercises.original: The coach believes she has enormous ability that has not yet been fully developed.
exercises.upgrade: The coach believes she has enormous potential that has not yet been fully developed.

options.explanation: not yet been fully developed 是關鍵線索。

words.note: 表示透過長期學習和經驗累積形成的高水平專業能力。
words.example: The project requires expertise in cybersecurity.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目需要網絡安全方面的專業能力。

exercises.original: The project requires advanced ability in data security.
exercises.upgrade: The project requires advanced expertise in data security.

exercises.original: We hired an outside consultant because we lacked the necessary ability in tax law.
exercises.upgrade: We hired an outside consultant because we lacked the necessary expertise in tax law.

words.meaning: 實務知識；訣竅；實際操作能力
words.note: 表示完成某件事所需的實際方法、經驗和操作知識。
words.example: The team has the technical know-how to repair the system without outside help.
words.exampleZh: 團隊具備自行修復系統所需的技術實務能力。

exercises.original: The technicians have the practical ability to repair the machines themselves.
exercises.upgrade: The technicians have the practical know-how to repair the machines themselves.

options.explanation: 強調實際知道怎樣操作和解決問題。

exercises.original: Starting the business required more than money; it also required technical ability.
exercises.upgrade: Starting the business required more than money; it also required technical know-how.

options.explanation: 商業／技術語境中表示實際操作知識。

words.meaning: 訣竅；特別擅長某事的本領
words.note: 表示一個人對某件事有一種自然、巧妙、似乎很順手的本領。
words.example: She has a knack for making nervous people feel comfortable.
words.exampleZh: 她很有本事令緊張的人放鬆下來。

exercises.original: She has an ability to make even very shy children start talking.
exercises.upgrade: She has a knack for making even very shy children start talking.

options.explanation: 口語地表示某人特別有辦法做某事。

exercises.original: He seems to have a special ability to find the simplest solution to practical problems.
exercises.upgrade: He seems to have a knack for finding the simplest solution to practical problems.

options.explanation: 有自然本領、很有辦法的語感。

words.note: 表示在某項活動中的卓越技巧或強大能力。
words.example: The athlete is known for her physical prowess.
words.exampleZh: 這名運動員以出色的身體能力聞名。

exercises.original: The player is admired for her exceptional athletic ability.
exercises.upgrade: The player is admired for her exceptional athletic prowess.

options.explanation: exceptional athletic 強調出眾高超能力。

exercises.original: The company became known for its technical ability in precision engineering.
exercises.upgrade: The company became known for its technical prowess in precision engineering.

options.explanation: 表示某領域出眾的高超能力。

words.note: 表示在商業、財務等領域中快速理解情況並作出好判斷的能力。
words.example: Her business acumen helped the company recover quickly.
words.exampleZh: 她敏銳的商業判斷力幫助公司迅速復甦。

exercises.original: Her business ability helped her recognize the opportunity before her competitors did.
exercises.upgrade: Her business acumen helped her recognize the opportunity before her competitors did.

options.explanation: business acumen 指敏銳商業判斷。
高超能力，但不特別指判斷。

exercises.original: Investors respected his ability to judge risks accurately.
exercises.upgrade: Investors respected his acumen in judging risks accurately.

options.explanation: 強調快速、準確理解和判斷。
經驗不等於判斷能力本身。

falseSynonyms.zh: possibility = 可能性；ability = 能不能做到。
falseSynonyms.point: There is a possibility of rain. She has the ability to solve the problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: qualification = 資格／證書；不等於實際能力。
experience = 經驗；經驗可建立能力，但不是能力本身。
knowledge = 知道甚麼；ability = 能否實際完成。
intelligence 只是能力的一部分；ability 可以是身體、藝術、社交、技術等。
performance = 某一次實際表現；ability = 整體能力。
potential = 未來可能發展；不代表現在已經做到。
talent 偏自然能力；skill 多數經學習和練習形成。
